Multi-feature guide

How to use this campus like a pro

Full-page layout: rail modes, collapsible curriculum, themes, search, resource atlas, study progress, focus mode.

📚

Rail modes

📚 Campus lessons · 🔗 Resource atlas (1050+) · ✦ Guide · 🗺 Paths · R RTMA cheat

⌨️

Keyboard

⌘/Ctrl K search⌘/Ctrl B navFocus buttonRandom ✦
🎨

Themes

Night Glass · Day Studio · Paper Clean · Rose Neon · Ember · Mint Lab — pick what keeps you studying.

🔁

Study loop

Read → experiment → RTMA artifact → mark studied → open related resources → re-test weekly canaries.

🧪

Runnable labs

bash scripts/verify_slice.sh — zero API keys. Mock brain honest if Ollama is down.

🎁

Share

Zip v4-PORTFOLIO.html.zip · still browser-friendly vs multi-hundred-MB dumps.

Audience paths

Pick a rail. Ignore the rest (for now).

①

A · Beginner

D00 → RTMA → D01/D05 → golden slice labs → resource atlas “Local Lab”.

②

B · Domain expert

RTMA ↔ your incident grammar → agents D09 → evals D11 → domain braid.

③

C · Engineer

D01 + D07 + D09 + D11 + D13 · read lab source · ship scorecards.

🪄

D · Hermes track

D10 fully · approval gates · coach patterns · never YOLO unattended high privilege.

🎙️

E · Voice/UC

D12 + sibling UC free pack · latency budgets · human handoff.

🦾

F · Future/robotics

D14 foresight · VLA/world models · safety first · sim before real.

Evidence grammar

Run · Trace · Metric · Artifact

AI twin of UC LICC. Falsifier first. If you cannot show these four, you do not yet know the lesson.

▶️

Run

Exact command, notebook, Hermes task, or lab script executed.

🧵

Trace

Request IDs, logs, tool-call chain, timeline of events.

📏

Metric

Latency, tokens, cost, pass rate, error rate, approval lag.

📦

Artifact

File you can reopen: JSON, report, checklist, scrubbed screenshot.

⚡

Falsifier

What observation would kill “the model is smart enough”?

🛡️

Perimeter

Permissions are perimeter when agents run tools. No unattended YOLO.
